title: Paxos sticky header
description: A plain white top bar (80px on phones, 102px on desktop): a mark and wordmark on the left, five quiet nav items centred, and a small slate pill on the right; on phones a menu button opens a dropdown list. It sticks to the top, slides up out of view (100px, fading) once you scroll down past ~450px, and comes back as soon as you scroll up.
notes: the hide-on-scroll needs JavaScript (hydrate: load); without it the bar simply stays put
the phone menu is a native details element
